title: Human acceptance recipe (recette) — specification
description: What an agent writes to describe a human acceptance run step by step. `bmad-plus uat build` turns it into a self-contained HTML page. Validation is performed by tools/cli/lib/uat.js; this file documents the contract.

id.description: Stable identifier, lowercase: <product>-<versions>. Used as file name and storage key.

date.description: ISO date the recipe was written.

title.description: What this delivery changes, in one sentence.

estimate.description: e.g. "25 min". Over the configured budget, lint asks for a split.

intro.description: Allowlisted inline markup: what the measurement showed, with its numbers.

warnings.description: Shown in orange: real writes, play order, prerequisites.

witnesses.description: Named test records. `proof` is the read-only query that establishes the state; `reads`/`writes` list the steps. Two recipes sharing a witness get an order.

after.description: Recipe ids that must be played before this one.

writes.description: True when the step persists something. Requires `verify`.

warning.description: Replaces the default orange sentence; use it when the product must REFUSE the attempted action.

optional.description: The tester may skip it; a skipped expectation never blocks the gate.

stories.description: Traceability to the delivery's acceptance criteria.

verify.description: The read-only confirmation run AFTER the tester: a tick on a writing step is not a write.

text.description: ONE verifiable observation, on-screen labels quoted word for word inside …. Lint refuses a label that exists in no source file.

authorNotes.description: The author's doubts (unverified witness, label to confirm). Ignored by the page, read by the reviewer.
